messages:
Priya Patel: Quick async check-in for HorizonPay — renewal in 12 days. High-level: adoption is stalled; raising the main blockers and owners.

Priya Patel: What I did: 1) ran onboarding audit, 2) scoped webhook retry fix, 3) documented renewal risks with the account exec.

Priya Patel: Blockers: 1) webhook failures when HorizonPay sends batched events -> downstream 502s; 2) SSO login errors for 3 users (SAML assertion mismatch); 3) need eng help to validate Dedicated slot capacity + KV warmup pattern.

Priya Patel: Today: ask eng-runtime to triage webhook hotfix, eng-platform for Dedicated QA, and PM/account to pause renewal comms until we stabilize.

Marco Li: Noted — I can take the webhook consumer investigation. Can you paste a minimal reproducer or curl with the failing payload?

Priya Patel: Pasting example (headers scrubbed):
```
curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood.dev/horizonpay/events \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"events":[{"id":"evt_123","type":"payment.succeeded","data":{...}}]}'
```

Priya Patel: Logs show 502 with `upstream read timeout` from the downstream service in the runtime logs.

Marco Li: OK will reproduce locally. Hypothesis: batching + single large POST triggers downstream timeout. Assigning to myself; will try chunked POST + backoff as a quick mitigation.

Alice Tran: SSO failures — I inspected the SAML response we send; looks like assertion_consumer_service_url mismatch for 2 of the 3 failing users. I emailed HorizonPay SSO admin with the metadata. CC'ing @Jordan Kim for platform cert rotation note.

Jordan Kim: For Dedicated QA: I can spin up a staging Dedicated slot with matching GPU profile and run a traffic spike (10k req/min) to reproduce. Need their typical sequence length and KV cache warmup behavior. Priya, can you share traces or token distribution?

Priya Patel: Sharing sanitized trace: avg request ~220 tokens; 95th ~480. Typical pattern: many short chats (20–60 tokens) followed by bursts of long sequence batch inference. KV warmup: repeated initial 1–2 long requests that warm cache then many short ones. Logs link (internal): https://redwood.internal/logs/horizonpay/flow-2026-06

support-bot: Incident created: CS-8342 "HorizonPay webhook 502s" assigned to Marco Li. Priority: P2.

Marco Li: Quick findings: our batching handler sometimes aggregates payloads >10MB which the downstream times out on (30s). Mitigation plan: cap batch size and stream events. Opening PR 5421 with a small handler change; will include a feature-flagged rollout. Requesting review from @Jordan Kim.

Jordan Kim: I'll review PR 5421 this afternoon. If it's config-only we can push to staging first, run the Dedicated spike, then promote.

Priya Patel: Action items recap: Marco -> PR + staging patch; Jordan -> review + run Dedicated QA; Alice -> confirm SSO fixes with HorizonPay admin; Priya -> renewal comms and follow-up on telemetry. I will update EOD PST. :white_check_mark:

Marco Li: ETA for hotfix ~6 hours. If the patch slips, fallback proposal: temporary rate-limiting on HorizonPay account to reduce batch sizes and failures.

Alice Tran: Update from HorizonPay SSO admin: they scheduled a metadata update for tomorrow 02:00 UTC.

Priya Patel: Scheduling customer call 48h before renewal, will include eng if hotfix lands. Thanks all :pray:
